title: References from tables outside the adapter are counted in one grouped call, WooCommerce's lookups no longer among them
steps: Run the grouped unknown-table reference count case on a real MariaDB.
expect: The grouped count answers as one count per number, over tables the adapter does not know.

cmd: --test-name-pattern=references from tables outside the adapter are counted in one grouped call
tests: references from tables outside the adapter are counted in one grouped call, with the same answer as one count per number
